# Score parity fixtures

`tracks.json` and `camera.json` come from the committed HUD exporters.
`resources.json` captures the score's live Slab machine control metadata and
factory preset values at Slab commit
`b8b6566dfaa7666779bd54e4c21c5b64ef2b0e9d`. It contains data, no DSP code or samples.
The expected output is the existing `score/ff_tracking.slab/project.json`,
generated by the unchanged Python score and committed in the original Slab PR.

`cargo test -p score` compares every document field, every ordered array and
every numeric value exactly (JSON integers and floats with the same value are
equivalent). The fixtures isolate this regression test from later edits to
installed presets. Live Python/Rust comparison is in `tools/check_score.py`.
